hooks.command: js_changes=$(git status --porcelain -- packages/js-core/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); new_changeset=$(git status --porcelain -- .changeset/ 2>/dev/null | grep -c '\.md$' || true); if [ "$js_changes" -gt 0 ] && [ "$new_changeset" -eq 0 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "Stop", "additionalContext": "REMINDER: packages/js-core/ has uncommitted changes but no new changeset file in .changeset/. Consider creating one with: pnpm changeset"}}'; fi
